pint_ae.notes: Official OpenPeppol PINT AE (UAE) validation artifacts: schematron (.sch), UNCL/PINT codelists (.gc) and official sample XMLs for trn-invoice and trn-creditnote. No pint-ae specific git repo exists under github.com/OpenPeppol; docs.peppol.eu publishes the versioned resources.zip that mirrors the repo build output.

schxslt.notes: XSLT-only release of the SchXslt schematron-to-XSLT compiler (github.com/schxslt/schxslt moved to codeberg.org/SchXslt/schxslt). The PINT AE .sch files declare queryBinding=xslt2, so compilation uses the 2.0/pipeline-for-svrl.xsl entry point.
